# Outline synthetic fixture v1

Purely synthetic zh-CN enterprise knowledge corpus; CC0-1.0.
Use `python -m tests.outline_oracles` from the repository root.
The manifest freezes each input byte. No generated index, customer data,
real model, business-quality claim or product performance baseline is included.
B/C asset/sample fields are fixture-only, not a public API.
Full int8 JSON integers are source truth; CF1-A wire maps to decimal strings.
